workflowTask.loopCondition: (function(){ var i = $.payment_attempts['iteration']; var last = $.payment_attempts[String(i)]; var approved = !!(last && last.attempt_payment && last.attempt_payment.result && last.attempt_payment.result.approved); return !approved && i < 5; })();

inputParameters.queryExpression:
(.attempt | if type == "number" and . >= 1 then floor else 1 end) as $i
| (.cart.seed // 0) as $seed
| ($seed % 3 + 2) as $acceptAt
| [
    (.cart.payment.label // "A firm handshake"),
    "Fax-Based Payment Gateway",
    "A Guy Named Dale",
    "Carrier-Pigeon Wire Transfer",
    "IOU Written on a Napkin"
  ] as $processors
| [
    "Declined: the card felt nervous.",
    "Declined: insufficient vibes.",
    "Timed out while the gateway finished its sandwich.",
    "Declined: the processor is on hold with itself.",
    "Declined: Mercury is in retrograde.",
    "Declined: we forgot what we were doing.",
    "Declined: the fax machine is out of toner again."
  ] as $declines
| ($i >= $acceptAt or $i >= 5) as $approved
| {
    attempt: $i,
    processor: ($processors[(if $i > 5 then 5 else $i end) - 1]),
    approved: $approved,
    message: (if $approved
      then "Approved. Nobody is more surprised than we are."
      else $declines[($seed + $i) % ($declines | length)] end)
  }

inputData.queryExpression:
[
  (.loop | if type == "object" then . else {} end)
  | to_entries[]
  | select(.key | test("^[0-9]+$"))
  | {n: (.key | tonumber), a: (.value.attempt_payment.result? // null)}
  | select(.a != null)
]
| sort_by(.n)
| map(.a) as $attempts
| ($attempts | map(select(.approved == true)) | last) as $winner
| {
    attempts: $attempts,
    attemptsNeeded: ($attempts | length),
    settled: true,
    settledBy: ($winner.processor // "House IOU (issued automatically)")
  }

inputData.queryExpression:
.cart as $c
| [
    "Allocated. We think.",
    "Allocated to someone else, but we're working on it.",
    "Substituted with a similar item (a brick).",
    "Backordered until morale improves.",
    "In stock, location unknown."
  ] as $notes

      $c.lines | to_entries[]
      | .value + {fulfilment: $notes[($c.seed + .key) % ($notes | length)]}
    ],
    trackingNumber: "TRK-\($c.seed)-LOST",
    carrier: $c.shipping.label,
    eta: $c.shipping.eta
  }

inputData.queryExpression:
.cart as $c
| .pricing as $p
| (.fulfilment | if type == "object" and (.lines | type) == "array" then . else null end) as $f
| {
    status: "CONFIRMED",
    rescued: false,
    orderId: $c.orderId,
    placedAt: $c.placedAt,
    customer: $c.customer,
    lines: ($f.lines // [$c.lines[] | . + {fulfilment: "Status unavailable. Assume the worst."}]),
    itemCount: $p.itemCount,
    subtotalCents: $p.subtotalCents,
    charges: $p.charges,
    totalCents: $p.totalCents,
    coupon: $c.coupon,
    payment: (.payment + {method: $c.payment.label}),
    shipping: {
      method: $c.shipping.label,
      eta: $c.shipping.eta,
      trackingNumber: ($f.trackingNumber // "TRK-PENDING-LOST")
    },
    loyaltyPoints: (0 - (($p.totalCents / 100 | floor) % 1000000000000000)),
    message: "Thank you for your purchase. No further questions, please."
  }

workflowDefinition.description: Chaos Commerce checkout. Prices the cart, tries payment processors until one accepts (the last one always does) and issues a receipt. Uses only system tasks, so no worker has to be running. If it fails or times out, chaos_checkout_rescue issues an emergency receipt instead.
